notes: Old SVG figures lived only in the question field and failed the validator (missing role/aria-label, and xmlns http:// tripped the external-resource check). All figures regenerated programmatically from each problem's own numbers: theme-safe currentColor strokes/labels, soft-opacity region fills, role/aria/viewBox, no external refs. Gears/ratio problems (bronze 2 & 4, silver 2, gold 1) left figure-free per the pure-formula rule. Added: opener, three teach walks, tier_guides, per-problem guided_steps + hints + tier descriptions, and expect values on every misconception (none previously had them). Units already in base SI (N, m) so no unit-conversion boxes were needed; walks follow the equation -> substitute -> compute -> answer-with-unit ritual with the completion boundary at the compute/rearrange step. Board-neutral throughout (no board named; moment equation framed as 'check whether your board also prints it on a sheet'). Tier ladder verified: bronze = one moment or a bare ratio; silver = balance two moments or ratio-to-speed; gold = multi-step (offset pivot, effort arm, multi-force, gears-to-speed). all_row_ids has a single canonical id (separate-sciences-ocr), so propagation patched 1 row; verified byte-identical live; validator PASS on the live row.
